description.narrative: The project will assist the Government of Madhya Pradesh (GOMP) in transforming its technical and vocational education and training (TVET) system to create a skilled workforce that meets the evolving development needs of the state. The project will establish a new advanced TVET institute of international standards to introduce high-quality, technology-oriented skills training for the state's priority sectors. The project will also modernize 10 major industrial training institutes (ITIs) by upgrading training infrastructure and curricula to impart quality, industry-relevant skills. The project aims to increase the employability, productivity, and incomes of the workforce, especially youth, women, and disadvantaged groups.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3710: 98% of contracts awarded and 88% disbursed as of 04 Jul 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: In 10 Divisional ITIs, 32 trades have been upgraded to NCVT certification, 385 candidates have been certified in Advanced Precision Engineering and 8 new courses will start in mid-2024, initially accommodating 240 students per course annually, increasing to 480 students.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Nov 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48493/48493-002-apfs-en_3.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Apr 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48493/48493-002-iee-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Feb 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48493/48493-002-smr-en_4.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 1a..Civil construction work of GSP:"Main academic block- 95% completed"Hostel, residential and external wall 62%completed"Project completion by November 2024. "Equipment installation is completed.1b. Training in 5 trades implemented."Equipment training for 4 courses under phase1 completed. "Training for the remaining 4 courses under phase 2 is underway." 1 batch of pedagogy training for 23 participants and 4 batches of technical training for 26 participants. completed by ITEES, Singapore. 275 trainees enrolled for 5 courses at GSP and are undergoing training in: oPrecision Engineering - 150oMechanical & Electrical Services 40,oMechanical Technology 28, oMechatronics 27,oAutomotive 30The operational plan for CAAT is in the final stage of completion and adoption.3a. A total of 869 youth with disability are trained (863 - 10Divisional ITI + 6 GSPCC).3b. An accessibility assessment has been completed in all 10 divisional ITIs. The analysis of the findings of the accessibility assessment reflects that all training facilities constructed or upgraded (GSP/ITIs) with barrier-free designs for people with disabilities.3c. Women's hostels are established in four ITIs (Indore, Jabalpur, Rewa, and Ujjain).3d. 140 Mobilization drives were organized for 10 Divisional ITIs and Global Skills Park in year 2023-2024.2a. Majority of the civil works is completed, and 10 sites have been handed over. MPHIDB is preparing the DPR for the remaining works. All the statutory and contractual compliances will be completed by September 2024.Procurement Status: Equipment under 51 packages have been delivered and installed in 10 ITIs.Operationalization: All the trades are operationalized in ITI's2b. DoSD has decided to offer 10252 admission seats under 10 upgraded divisional ITIs.2c. Placement and apprenticeship cell established at the state level. Placement Officers deployed at the 10 Divisional ITIs to oversee placement activities. 55% placement achieved.2d. Achieved Results: 320 master trainers created.2e. 940 trainers have been trained out of which 179 are female candidates and training is under progress.The GSP Society was established in October 2018 to ensure its autonomous and professional management. Recruitment of CEO is under progress. Senior Director and CEO are appointed.The MPSDP and GSP website is active. The development for the MIS and Dashboard is in progress.TVET management/ leadership training was organized by ITEES with support from Temasek Foundation for a total of 120 leaders/officials. Two batches of leaders/trainers completed the training in March and April 2022 for a total number of 58 participants. Further visits of senior management and GSP trainers is planned to ITEES for leadership and padegology trainings.137 officials from DOSD and other skills agencies completed TVET management and leadership training. (Temasek Foundation/ NITTTR).Institutional Development Plans for all 10 Divisional ITIs is prepared. (Monitoring Framework under preparation.)GRC has been constituted in 10 Divisional ITIs and Safeguard officers have been deputed in all 10 divisional ITIs.
